name: spendly-ai
description: Spendly AI — a privacy-first personal spending tracker with an evidence-backed AI money coach.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev -w @spendly/api" "npm run dev -w @spendly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spendly/web && npm run build -w @spendly/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
